name: When should I consider re-tiling my shower?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider re-tiling my shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider re-tiling your shower if you notice signs of water damage, such as peeling paint or bulging walls outside the shower, persistent mold or mildew that returns after cleaning, or cracked and crumbling grout. Outdated aesthetics or a desire for a fresh, modern look are also common reasons. Addressing issues like persistent leaks or damaged substrate early can prevent more extensive and costly repairs down the line. A professional assessment can help determine the extent of necessary work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider re-tiling if you see water damage, persistent mold, cracked grout, or if you want to update the shower's look. Early intervention can prevent bigger issues.
